verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 35.115
verses.english: Linked Discourses 35.115

verses.pali: 12. Lokakāmaguṇavagga
verses.english: 12. The World and the Kinds of Sensual Stimulation

verses.pali: Dutiyamārapāsasutta
verses.english: Māra’s Snare (2nd)

verses.pali: “Santi, bhikkhave, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṁhitā rajanīyā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, there are sights known by the eye, which are likable, desirable, agreeable, pleasant, sensual, and arousing.

verses.pali: Tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati—
verses.english: If a mendicant approves, welcomes, and keeps clinging to them,

verses.pali: ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu baddho cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu, āvāsagato mārassa, mārassa vasaṁ gato, paṭimukkassa mārapāso.
verses.english: they’re called a mendicant who is bound in sights known by the eye. They’re trapped in Māra’s lair, fallen under Māra’s sway, and caught in Māra’s snare.

verses.pali: Baddho so mārabandhanena yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato …pe….
verses.english: They’re bound by Māra’s bonds, and the Wicked One can do with them what he wants.

verses.pali: Santi, bhikkhave, jivhāviññeyyā rasā …pe…
verses.english: There are sounds … smells … tastes … touches …

verses.pali: santi, bhikkhave, manoviññeyyā dhammā, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṁhitā rajanīyā.
verses.english: ideas known by the mind, which are likable, desirable, agreeable, pleasant, sensual, and arousing.

verses.pali: Tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati—
verses.english: If a mendicant approves, welcomes, and keeps clinging to them,

verses.pali: ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu baddho manoviññeyyesu dhammesu, āvāsagato mārassa, mārassa vasaṁ gato, paṭimukkassa mārapāso.
verses.english: they’re called a mendicant who is bound in ideas known by the mind. They’re trapped in Māra’s lair, fallen under Māra’s sway, and caught in Māra’s snare.

verses.pali: Baddho so mārabandhanena yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato …pe….
verses.english: They’re bound by Māra’s bonds, and the Wicked One can do with them what he wants.

verses.pali: Santi ca kho, bhikkhave, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṁhitā rajanīyā.
verses.english: There are sights known by the eye, which are likable, desirable, agreeable, pleasant, sensual, and arousing.

verses.pali: Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati—
verses.english: If a mendicant doesn’t approve, welcome, and keep clinging to them,

verses.pali: ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu mutto cakkhuviññeyyehi rūpehi, nāvāsagato mārassa, na mārassa vasaṁ gato, ummukkassa mārapāso.
verses.english: they’re called a mendicant who is freed from sights known by the eye. They’re not trapped in Māra’s lair, not fallen under Māra’s sway, and released from Māra’s snare.

verses.pali: Mutto so mārabandhanena na yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato …pe….
verses.english: They’re free from Māra’s bonds, and the Wicked One cannot do with them what he wants.

verses.pali: Santi, bhikkhave, jivhāviññeyyā rasā …pe…
verses.english: There are sounds … smells … tastes … touches …

verses.pali: santi, bhikkhave, manoviññeyyā dhammā, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṁhitā rajanīyā.
verses.english: ideas known by the mind, which are likable, desirable, agreeable, pleasant, sensual, and arousing.

verses.pali: Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati—
verses.english: If a mendicant doesn’t approve, welcome, and keep clinging to them,

verses.pali: ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu mutto manoviññeyyehi dhammehi, nāvāsagato mārassa, na mārassa vasaṁ gato, ummukkassa mārapāso.
verses.english: they’re called a mendicant who is freed from ideas known by the mind. They’re not trapped in Māra’s lair, not fallen under Māra’s sway, and released from Māra’s snare.

verses.pali: Mutto so mārabandhanena na yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato”ti.
verses.english: They’re free from Māra’s bonds, and the Wicked One cannot do with them what he wants.”

verses.pali: Dutiyaṁ.
